title: Consequences of AI | COPICafe Episode 38 | Cornucopias
description:
Philosophical debates on AI, updates on the website and much more!

In episode 38 of COPI Cafe, Rob and Josh discuss the latest updates on the PC game. Rob talks about our mobile game progress and later go on to discuss the racing game. The guys then go on to explain where we currently stand on the new website and when we can expect it to be launched. Shortly after, they discuss their strategy for marketing in 2023 and then get into a juicy leak! To finish it off Rob and Josh get into a topical discussion on the consequences of the exponential advancement of AI!

00:00 - Beverage Choices
02:59 - Gaming Nostalgia
06:33 - PC Game Updates
08:14 - Mobile Game Updates
12:53 - Racing Game Updates
15:23 - Website Updates
17:21 - 2023 Marketing
21:00 - Leak!
22:21 - Character Needs System
32:25 - The Consequences of AI

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw
